page: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Eadv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with 16 physical cores and 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The CPU cache configuration includes 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It includes 1890 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, with no bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Multi-core capabilities are also notable, with bzip3 multi-threaded decompression and Geekbench multi-core scores reaching the top 25%, though stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Passmark CPU scores remain in the middle 50%. Memory performance is highlighted by a Passmark memory score in the top 25%, while uncached memory bandwidth read and write speeds sit in the middle 50% at 75.65 GB/sec and 55.63 GB/sec respectively. For specialized workloads, the server achieves top 10% performance in text generation for small (135M) LLM models, alongside average performance for medium and large LLM models.

Given the 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and the inclusion of 1890 GB of local storage, this server offers high resource density for memory-intensive and storage-reliant workloads without the added cost of GPU hardware. It is suitable for database operations, memory-cached applications, large-scale text and image processing, and software compilation.

It features 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores), 256.0 GB of RAM, and 1890 GB of local storage. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server delivers strong single-core and multi-core performance, with Geekbench and Passmark memory scores placing in the top 25%. It also demonstrates top-tier efficiency in small-model LLM text generation. With an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio and Premium Storage capability, the E32ads_v6 provides a balanced profile for memory-intensive workloads. It is well-suited for database hosting, large-scale text and image processing, and memory-cached applications.
